Indian Railways Announces Special Trains for Festive Season

Indian Railways has announced the operation of special trains to accommodate increased passenger demand during the festive season, including Durga Puja, Diwali, and Chhath. One route mentioned connects Delhi and Ashoknagar. The trains are intended to facilitate travel for those going home for the festivals. Specific timings and routes for these special services have been detailed.
